description: Defines data structures and functions related to PDSCH antenna ports mapping for 5G NR, including a struct for mapping info and functions to retrieve mapping tables and indices based on configuration parameters.

classes.name: pdsch_antenna_ports_mapping
classes.description: Holds information about PDSCH antenna ports mapping, including DMRS ports, number of DMRS groups without data, and front load symbols.

methods.name: get_pdsch_antenna_port_mapping_table
methods.description: Retrieves the PDSCH antenna ports mapping table based on DM-RS configuration parameters.

methods.name: get_pdsch_antenna_port_mapping
methods.description: Returns the specific PDSCH antenna ports mapping based on input configuration parameters.

methods.name: get_pdsch_antenna_port_mapping_row_index
methods.description: Returns the index of the PDSCH antenna ports mapping row in TS 38.212 tables based on configuration.
